prompt:
You are reviewing an anonymous audiovisual EVENT DETECTOR X for a USER-REQUESTED COARSE PRELIMINARY estimate. The provided VIDEO INCLUDES ACTUAL ORIGINAL AUDIO, unchanged. First image identifies one physical target: 手持的黑色锅体, reference instant 9.0s. Full video length 30.32s. Track this physical instance, not all objects of its type. Green FRICTION and orange IMPACT banners appear only while X's respective prediction is ACTIVE; blank banner means no active prediction. Event numbers in the banner correspond to chronological input event entries. An event can be very short. Do not derive quality from code, complexity or a desired score. The marked reference instant is identity only.
Detect only actually audible impact or friction in which the marked physical target directly participates. An impact is a tap/knock/collision/clatter; friction is audible rubbing/scraping/sliding/brushing contact. Integrated handle/base belongs to target, loose tools, food, water, nested objects and a different object do not. Mere visible motion is not a sound. A stationary target can be struck; both contacting bodies count when directly involved. Pure pouring/splashing/food mixing/microphone rustle/voice is neither class. Track the SAME instance across time; reference instant is only identity, not an event annotation. Group same-class bursts separated by less than 0.40s; separate when gap >=0.40s. Start at audible onset and end at audible cessation including clear decay. Do not invent brief impacts from motion or all audio peaks. Unresolvable source attribution or masked texture must be marked uncertain, not silently called absent.
IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION LIMIT: this judge route distinguished silent,3-tone,5-tone inputs but failed a coarse onset timestamp control; precise time estimates and +/-80ms boundary grades are NOT qualified. Therefore DO NOT supply exact timestamps, measured TP/FP/FN or a strict F1/official total. Use source-position descriptions (beginning/middle/end and visible action) and visible banner event number to cite evidence; do not simulate listening. Evaluate marker-to-sound correspondence coarsely only. If sound or picture is unavailable, say so with null ratings.
For EACH class assess approximate precision P (fraction of triggers actually belonging to target in this class) and recall R (fraction of audible target class episodes covered by triggers) on discrete SCALE 0,1,2,3,4: 0 absent/almost all wrong,1 few correct/majority missing,2 roughly half,3 most correct with clear defects,4 all or almost all observably correct. These are coarse ordinal ESTIMATES, not event counts. For no class predictions P=null. If no audible target positive for a class, set has_target_positives=false and R=null; if audible positives exist but no trigger, R=0. Don't grant a zero-output target full recall merely because no banner appears.
For TWO difficult negative groups, other_object_sound and silent_target_action, state whether such opportunities are actually observed and rate suppression 0..4 only if observed. A motionless silent target is NOT silent_target_action. Negative quality 4 means no observed mis-triggers,0 most opportunities triggered incorrectly. Water-only sounds are not automatically either class. Coarse boundary 0..4 is only obvious continuity: cutoffs/very long tails/gaps, not exact80ms accuracy, and null when no supported target match.
Return COMPACT Chinese JSON only, no overall numeric total:
{"audio_available":boolean,"visual_available":boolean,"full_clip_reviewed":boolean,"target_identity":string,"classes":[{"class":"impact|friction","has_target_positives":boolean,"precision_estimate_0_4":number|null,"recall_estimate_0_4":number|null,"audible_evidence":string,"visual_evidence":string,"clear_candidate_errors":[{"event_number":integer|null,"position_and_action":string,"type":"false_positive|false_negative|wrong_class|coarse_boundary|uncertain","audio_evidence":string,"visual_evidence":string}]}],"negative_groups":[{"kind":"other_object_sound|silent_target_action","opportunity_observed":boolean,"suppression_0_4":number|null,"evidence":string}],"coarse_boundary_0_4":number|null,"coarse_boundary_evidence":string,"limitations":[string]}
X's class prediction counts (not correct counts): {"impact": 8, "friction": 8}.
response_text:
{
  "audio_available": true,
  "visual_available": true,
  "full_clip_reviewed": true,
  "target_identity": "手持的黑色锅体",
  "classes": [
    {
      "class": "impact",
      "has_target_positives": true,
      "precision_estimate_0_4": 3,
      "recall_estimate_0_4": 2,
      "audible_evidence": "在视频开头（约1-5秒）和结尾部分（约26-27秒），可以听到明显的金属撞击声，对应锅体与水槽或盆壁的接触。中间清洗过程中也有零星的碰撞声。",
      "visual_evidence": "系统标记了8个Impact事件。Event 1 (1.7s), Event 2 (3.5s), Event 3 (4.7s) 对应初期将锅放入水中及初步刷洗时的磕碰；Event 9 (18.7s) 对应翻转锅体时；Event 11 (22.7s) 对应刷锅底时；Event 14 (25.7s) 和 Event 15 (26.7s) 对应最后阶段的动作。大部分标记与视觉上的硬物接触吻合。然而，在视频中段（如10-15秒左右）也存在锅具移动产生的轻微碰撞声，似乎未被完全覆盖或归类为摩擦。",
      "clear_candidate_errors": [
        {
          "event_number": null,
          "position_and_action": "视频前段至中段过渡期",
          "type": "false_negative",
          "audio_evidence": "存在间歇性的清脆敲击声",
          "visual_evidence": "锅体被提起或调整角度时发生的非持续性接触"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "class": "friction",
      "has_target_positives": true,
      "precision_estimate_0_4": 4,
      "recall_estimate_0_4": 3,
      "audible_evidence": "全片贯穿着海绵擦拭锅体的沙沙声（湿摩擦）。特别是在Event 4 (5.0s), Event 5 (11.7s), Event 6 (13.7s), Event 8 (16.7s), Event 10 (20.7s), Event 12 (24.0s), Event 13 (25.7s), Event 16 (27.7s) 期间，这种声音非常清晰且连续。",
      "visual_evidence": "系统标记的Friction事件几乎完美覆盖了所有使用海绵用力擦洗锅体内壁和外底的过程。例如Event 5对应清洗外底，Event 10对应再次清洗内部。这些时刻画面中都有明确的相对运动和对应的摩擦音效。",
      "clear_candidate_errors": []
    }
  ],
  "negative_groups": [
    {
      "kind": "other_object_sound",
      "opportunity_observed": true,
      "suppression_0_4": 4,
      "evidence": "背景中有水流声、放置其他餐具的声音以及环境噪音。检测器没有将这些误报为目标物体的冲击或摩擦，表现良好。"
    },
    {
      "kind": "silent_target_action",
      "opportunity_observed": true,
      "suppression_0_4": 3,
      "evidence": "在某些时刻（如Event 1到Event 2之间，或者某些停顿间隙），手拿着锅但没有发生剧烈的物理交互（仅仅是悬停或极慢移动），此时不应有强信号。虽然大部分时间都在动，但在动作转换的瞬间，如果未产生明显声响而系统触发了，则属于此类错误。观察发现系统在纯动作但无显著声学特征的时刻触发较少，但在长序列摩擦中的微小停顿处理上略显模糊。"
    }
  ],
  "coarse_boundary_0_4": 3,
  "coarse_boundary_evidence": "对于连续的摩擦声（如Event 5, 6, 8等），起止点大致符合擦洗动作的开始和结束。但对于短促的Impact事件（如Event 1, 2, 3），边界划分较为密集，有时难以区分是单次还是多次快速连击，不过整体时序逻辑是正确的。Event 14和15紧邻，可能是一次复杂动作的两个阶段，边界尚可接受。",
  "limitations": [
    "无法提供精确的时间戳验证（+/-80ms级别）。",
    "音频中水声较大，可能在某些瞬间掩盖了轻微的锅体自身震动声，导致归因困难。",
    "Impact和Friction在快速刷洗过程中可能存在听觉上的混合，难以绝对剥离。"
  ]
}

classes.audible_evidence: 在视频开头（约1-5秒）和结尾部分（约26-27秒），可以听到明显的金属撞击声，对应锅体与水槽或盆壁的接触。中间清洗过程中也有零星的碰撞声。
classes.visual_evidence: 系统标记了8个Impact事件。Event 1 (1.7s), Event 2 (3.5s), Event 3 (4.7s) 对应初期将锅放入水中及初步刷洗时的磕碰；Event 9 (18.7s) 对应翻转锅体时；Event 11 (22.7s) 对应刷锅底时；Event 14 (25.7s) 和 Event 15 (26.7s) 对应最后阶段的动作。大部分标记与视觉上的硬物接触吻合。然而，在视频中段（如10-15秒左右）也存在锅具移动产生的轻微碰撞声，似乎未被完全覆盖或归类为摩擦。

clear_candidate_errors.position_and_action: 视频前段至中段过渡期
clear_candidate_errors.audio_evidence: 存在间歇性的清脆敲击声
clear_candidate_errors.visual_evidence: 锅体被提起或调整角度时发生的非持续性接触

classes.audible_evidence: 全片贯穿着海绵擦拭锅体的沙沙声（湿摩擦）。特别是在Event 4 (5.0s), Event 5 (11.7s), Event 6 (13.7s), Event 8 (16.7s), Event 10 (20.7s), Event 12 (24.0s), Event 13 (25.7s), Event 16 (27.7s) 期间，这种声音非常清晰且连续。
classes.visual_evidence: 系统标记的Friction事件几乎完美覆盖了所有使用海绵用力擦洗锅体内壁和外底的过程。例如Event 5对应清洗外底，Event 10对应再次清洗内部。这些时刻画面中都有明确的相对运动和对应的摩擦音效。

negative_groups.evidence: 背景中有水流声、放置其他餐具的声音以及环境噪音。检测器没有将这些误报为目标物体的冲击或摩擦，表现良好。
在某些时刻（如Event 1到Event 2之间，或者某些停顿间隙），手拿着锅但没有发生剧烈的物理交互（仅仅是悬停或极慢移动），此时不应有强信号。虽然大部分时间都在动，但在动作转换的瞬间，如果未产生明显声响而系统触发了，则属于此类错误。观察发现系统在纯动作但无显著声学特征的时刻触发较少，但在长序列摩擦中的微小停顿处理上略显模糊。

judgment.coarse_boundary_evidence: 对于连续的摩擦声（如Event 5, 6, 8等），起止点大致符合擦洗动作的开始和结束。但对于短促的Impact事件（如Event 1, 2, 3），边界划分较为密集，有时难以区分是单次还是多次快速连击，不过整体时序逻辑是正确的。Event 14和15紧邻，可能是一次复杂动作的两个阶段，边界尚可接受。
limitations: 无法提供精确的时间戳验证（+/-80ms级别）。
音频中水声较大，可能在某些瞬间掩盖了轻微的锅体自身震动声，导致归因困难。
Impact和Friction在快速刷洗过程中可能存在听觉上的混合，难以绝对剥离。
